Class PaperItemBehavior

java.lang.Object
net.momirealms.craftengine.core.item.behavior.ItemBehavior
fr.robie.machineengine.api.paper.PaperItemBehavior
public abstract class PaperItemBehavior extends net.momirealms.craftengine.core.item.behavior.ItemBehavior
A CraftEngine item behavior written with Bukkit types (D32): right-clicks with the item in the main hand arrive as one use(Use), whether on a block or in the air, and useOnEntity(Player, ItemStack, Entity) on an entity. Return true when the click was handled: it is then cancelled, as a listener would.

CraftEngine calls these on the player's thread. A click on a vanilla block that opens something (a chest, a furnace) reaches the item only while the player sneaks; a click on a machine reaches it only when the behavior is also a MachineTool.
